name: ef2_london44
what: P(this side wins | buying THIS side at THIS ask at THIS second), fitted ONLY on the features London's final-test table carries.
why_a_separate_model: Scoring London's table with the 52-feature model and imputing the 8 it lacks keeps AUC (0.8608 -> 0.8573) but INVERTS the trading result (win 65.9% -> 32.5%, per $1 +0.016 -> -0.076). AUC is rank-based and survives imputation; the decision depends on the calibrated LEVEL of p_win against the price, and the missing features carry 34.2% of the coefficient mass. Refitting on London's own keys restores it: walk-forward AUC 0.8609 on 44 features against 0.8608 on 52, and per $1 +0.020 against +0.016. USE THIS ONE ON LONDON'S TABLE.
caveat: Refitted on ALL days for export. Out-of-sample numbers are in analysis/zurich/EF2.md. In-sample AUC here is 0.8566 and must not be quoted as performance.

decision_rule.price_for_decision: the QUOTED ask, never the fill price
decision_rule.walk_forward_best: margin 0.02: per $1 +0.020, total +161.1, 89.8% sim fill, 66.0% win, halves +0.028/+0.012, perm 0.007 - and it still does NOT pass the owner's bar, which requires beating fixed15 on per $1 as well

not_a_deploy: A scorer for London to evaluate its own real attempts. Not a config; arms nothing.
london44: THIS IS THE london44 MODEL. Fitted on exactly the 44 features London's final-test table can supply; the 8 it cannot are not imputed, they are absent from the fit. Score London's 654 attempts with THIS file, not with ef2_model.json.
do_not_use_the_52_feature_model_on_londo: ef2_model.json has 52 features. Scoring London's table with it and imputing the 8 missing keys keeps AUC almost unchanged (0.8608 -> 0.8573) but INVERTS the trading result: win 65.9% -> 32.5%, per $1 +0.016 -> -0.076, total +128 -> -573. AUC is rank-based and survives imputation; the decision depends on the calibrated LEVEL of p_win against the price, and the missing features carry 34.2% of the coefficient mass. That is why london44 exists.

walk_forward.note: london44 matches the 52-feature model to 0.0001 - the 8 dropped features add nothing once the model is calibrated without them.
